text: SELECT molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, molecule_dictionary.molecule_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM docs JOIN compound_records ON docs.doc_id = compound_records.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary ON compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133022'
